name: Coatlicue

domain_history.domain: "Mother of the gods and mortals," earth-mother figure; mother of Huitzilopochtli in the Coatepec myth; represented with serpent-skirt and skull/dismemberment iconography read by scholars as characteristic Mexica pairing of creation and destruction

notes: Represented in the colossal Coatlicue statue (Mexica sculpture, Museo Nacional de Antropología). General iconographic consensus, moderate-to-high confidence.
